name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A Government of India income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. Eligibility and exclusions must be checked against the current official guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: A government-supported lending initiative intended to improve access to institutional credit for eligible micro-enterprises and business activities. Loan conditions depend on the applicable scheme and lender guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: A Government of India initiative supporting LPG connections for eligible households. Current beneficiary criteria and required documents must be confirmed through the official scheme information.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: The National Scholarship Portal provides a platform for students to discover and apply for participating government scholarship schemes. Eligibility, income limits, academic requirements and deadlines depend on the individual scholarship.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
description: A Government of India health assurance scheme providing eligible beneficiaries access to covered hospital treatment. Eligibility and benefits must be verified using the official beneficiary and scheme information.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A contributory pension scheme for eligible subscribers, with pension benefits subject to applicable conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance support for eligible farmers against specified crop losses, subject to policy and seasonal conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: A contributory pension scheme for eligible small and marginal farmers, subject to enrollment requirements.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil testing information and nutrient recommendations to support informed farming decisions.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Supports eligible investments in agriculture infrastructure through financing assistance under applicable guidelines.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Provides eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople access to training, toolkit support, credit and market-linkage assistance.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: A lending initiative supporting eligible street vendors with working-capital credit and related incentives.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Supports eligible entrepreneurs establishing new micro-enterprises through credit-linked assistance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides housing assistance to eligible rural households under applicable programme guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Supports eligible urban households in accessing affordable housing assistance under current programme rules.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Supports eligible residential rooftop solar installations under applicable subsidy and application conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Provides maternity-related financial assistance to eligible pregnant and lactating women, subject to scheme conditions.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: A maternal-health programme intended to encourage institutional deliveries among eligible beneficiaries.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: A renewable life insurance scheme for eligible account holders, subject to enrollment and premium requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: An accident insurance scheme for eligible account holders, subject to enrollment and policy conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: A contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised-sector workers, subject to age and income requirements.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
description: An umbrella programme providing social assistance through different components for eligible vulnerable households.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Provides pension assistance to eligible older persons under the National Social Assistance Programme.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Provides pension assistance to eligible widows under the National Social Assistance Programme.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Provides pension assistance to eligible persons with disabilities under the National Social Assistance Programme.
